  FROM cards
  WHERE instr(',' || availability || ',', ',arena,') > 0 AND supertypes IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1), substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1)
  FROM tokens WHERE rest <> ''
), subtype_tokens(value, rest) AS (
  SELECT '', COALESCE(subtypes, '') || ','
  FROM cards
  WHERE instr(',' || availability || ',', ',arena,') > 0 AND subtypes IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1), substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1)
  FROM subtype_tokens WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT trim(value) AS type
FROM (SELECT value FROM tokens UNION ALL SELECT value FROM subtype_tokens)
WHERE trim(value) <> ''
ORDER BY type;

FROM sets
WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';
